$comment: Generated from pipeline/snowlight/schemas by `uv run python -m snowlight.schemas`. Do not edit.

ContentDigest.description: A SHA-256 digest: 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

DayMinute.description: Minutes after the start of the day in the school's own zone: negative for a change before the day began (a closing announced the evening before).

DirectoryStamp.description:
The directory a file's school and district indexes point into.

It must equal generated_on, count and the number of districts of the
schools/meta.json the reader has loaded; otherwise the file is ignored.
DirectoryStamp.title: DirectoryStamp

LocalDate.description: A calendar day in the school's own time zone: YYYY-MM-DD.

MinuteOfDay.description: A local wall-clock time as minutes after midnight (630 is 10:30).

Reason.description:
The weather named for a status or a forecast.

0 winter storm, 1 ice, 2 extreme cold, 3 flooding, 4 hurricane,
5 severe storms, 6 heat, 7 power outage.
Reason.title: Reason

SchemaVersion.description: The file format's version. A reader refuses a file with any other.

SchoolGap.description: A school index written as its distance from the one before it: index = previous index + 1 + gap, and the first previous index is -1. So [4, 0, 2] is schools 4, 5 and 8.

ShiftMinutes.description: A length of time in whole minutes.

Status.description:
What a school is doing on a day because of weather.

0 closed, 1 delayed start, 2 remote or e-learning, 3 early dismissal.
Status.title: Status

UtcInstant.description: A moment in UTC, whole seconds: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

description:
live/days/<day>.json: when each school's status for one local day changed.

One run per school that showed a status for the day, in school order: ``counts[i]``
changes for the i-th school, read in order from the flat columns. A change is the
status the map showed from that minute on (``null``: none, the status was taken
back), with its reason and, for a delay or an early dismissal, its shift and clock
time (one entry in ``shifts`` and ``clocks`` per such change, in order). A day in
progress has ``final`` false and grows; once the day is over everywhere it is
written one last time with ``final`` true.

content_sha256.description: The content digest of the directory edition the school indexes were built from (two contents can share one stamp); null for an emptied file.

counts.description: How many changes each school has.

gaps.description: Each school, as a gap from the previous school's index.

statuses.description: Each change's status; null when the status was taken back.

title: DayTimeline
